clue.text: One relative pockets jewellery: and the others?

definitions.text: One relative pockets jewellery: and the others?

indicators.note: to pocket something is to take it inside, so the relative's letters enclose the jewellery

parts.note: one relative, a sister, is SIS for short
bling is slang for showy jewellery

explanation.surface: A family member slips some jewellery into a pocket, prompting the question of what the rest of the family are up to.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: a sister plus all the other brothers and sisters make up the siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: Brothers and sisters together, one sister and the rest of them, form a set of siblings.

clue.text: Thus, African country borders a different one

parts.note: so means thus, in that way
Mali is a country in West Africa

explanation.surface: One African state is said to share a frontier with another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'African country' looks like the definition but supplies the middle; the answer is a different African country.
explanation.definitionFit: Somalia is another nation of Africa, on the Horn, distinct from Mali.

clue.text: Obstruct using a measure of pressure

definitions.meaning: to obstruct is to block or prevent
a unit of atmospheric pressure used by meteorologists

explanation.definitionFit: To bar is to block; the bar is also a unit of pressure equal to 100,000 pascals.

clue.text: Washing-up is done so for it

definitions.text: Washing-up is done so for it

parts.words: Washing-up is done so for it
parts.note: dishes are cleaned ..., and being in trouble is the idiomatic sense

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in trouble, and literally describes where dishes are washed.

clue.text: Relish seeing us totally content

indicators.note: the content of these words is what lies inside them

explanation.surface: Someone is overjoyed to find we are completely happy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like happy; it is what the phrase contains.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is enjoyment or enthusiastic relish for something.

clue.text: Affected an elegant greeting

parts.note: chic means stylish or elegant
hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: Someone's showy hello is dismissed as pretentious and put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Chichi describes something pretentiously or fussily refined, i.e. affected in style.

clue.text: Not the first to turn — on this?

definitions.text: Not the first to turn — on this?

indicators.note: not the first means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: to wheel is to turn

explanation.surface: Someone asks what you swivel on when you are not the first to turn.
explanation.walkthrough: One turns on one's heel; the whole clue plays on that idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom turn on one's heel means spin round abruptly on the back of the foot.

clue.text: Very keen on curious gap in very irregular path

parts.note: crazy about means very keen on

indicators.note: curious means odd, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone fond of an odd gap in a very uneven garden walk.

clue.text: Given a key vote, sure to hold it

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so the vote goes inside

parts.note: indeed means certainly, sure
X is the mark made when voting

explanation.surface: A voter is handed a key and is sure to keep the ballot.

clue.text: In which man's extremely sulky, right?

definitions.text: In which man's extremely sulky, right?

parts.note: his means belonging to a man

indicators.note: extremely points to the extreme ends of the word sulky

parts.note: fit means right or suitable

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes a tantrum, in which a man's very sulky.
explanation.definitionFit: A tantrum or fit of petulance is a state of extreme sulkiness.

clue.text: In disarray, haven't managed upfront to arrange holiday island

indicators.note: upfront points to the very front of the word managed, its first letter
to arrange letters is to put them in a new order, so the letters before it are reshuffled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, ignoring the apostrophe

explanation.walkthrough: 'In disarray' looks like the anagram signal, but 'disarray' is itself fodder; the signal is 'to arrange'.

clue.text: Beamer, quick-moving, in front of mansion

clue.text: Sexton makes king nastily aggrieved

indicators.note: nastily suggests something twisted, so the letters are reshuffled

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: These said to make chain for cat

parts.note: these are the parts that make a chain: links

explanation.walkthrough: 'to make chain' explains 'These': the links of a chain.
explanation.definitionFit: The lynx is a wild member of the feline family with tufted ears.

clue.text: Wife not thoughtful enough for prodigy

parts.note: under-kind, playfully, means not kind enough

clue.text: Book doubly a laugh? Not quite

clue.text: Banned drink as evil — a bishop has article about it

clue.text: Awfully loud RAF tie

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Lady, incomparable, not fifty

clue.text: Pony oddly tripping over daisy damages this?

indicators.note: tripping over a thing means having it at one's feet, so it sits within

clue.text: Giving order appeal is to be rejected — being executed

clue.text: News at Ten's first item something hard to grasp, to be polite

clue.text: Almost whirl round very wide boy

clue.text: One blooming break, doctor, and no end of pain

clue.text: Bishop say something of a shepherd to the church
